Neynar Seeks New Team to Run Farcaster and Clanker  > Neynar is looking for a new team to take over Farcaster, Clanker, and its related products, with the company returning its balance sheet and team members moving on after deciding it is no longer the right…

tweet.text:
Farcaster was a great infra/app experiment, but it’s clear that a decentralized social graph itself isn’t the value prop that pulls users away from incumbents like Twitter.

The behavior is social trading that turns discovery of new tokens, speculation  and pnl as reputation into one native product loop. That’s something the existing social incumbents can’t built today so harder for X or Insta to copy or compete 

The hard part is that you usually only see the final form after a long chain of startups, one slowly building on top of each other to get to the final form

MetaMask ->Phantom ->Farcaster -> Moonshot -> Vector -> Fomo / Pump

Each one teaches you something about what users actually care about. In hindsight this feels obvious, but it took years of investments, products and assumptions to get to the answer.

recent_posts.text: Neynar to Acquire Farcaster  > Neynar is acquiring Farcaster and will take over ownership of its protocol contracts, code repositories, app, and Clanker.  Source: https://farcaster.xyz/dwr/0x72aab3a5

tweet.text:
update on @farcaster_xyz, @clanker_world and @neynarxyz  

we’ve started a process to look for a new home / team to run the products going forward. 

earlier this year, this seemed to be a good fit for our team: it was a developer-first network, and we'd been serving developers from the start. There’s been a lot of change since then and we’re not the right fit for what’s needed next. 

talking to a few teams we think could be a good fit for running decentralized social apps and related developer products. If you’ve thoughts / are interested, reach out.   

our company will return its balance sheet (most of it remains) and team members will move on to something new. 

this is not a decision we made lightly. I’m optimistic that with this next iteration, Farcaster will find its long term fit. 

it’s loved enough that it’s unlikely to simply perish - thanks to all of you, and lindy-ness.

Dear Printr community,

Today, we’re sharing that Printr will commence its wind-down process and all operations will cease by 31 August 2026.

Over the past three months, we have pursued every option available to reach a sustainable path forward. Without the capital or the distribution backing that today's market requires, Printr is no longer sustainable.

Starting from 18 August 2026, every staked position and fees earned from staking across all supported chains will be automatically unstaked/claimed and transferred to the wallet address it was deposited from. The staking feature will be paused subsequently.

If you have not received your assets after 20 August 2026, please reach out to us on Discord before 31 August 2026.
